what: While the section is pinned for 1 screen so the whole card group fits on screen, the cards sit stacked at one point at the bottom center of the screen (lower by the first card’s height) at ±14° (alternating) · .92x · transparent. Following the scroll (scrub .6), each card flies into its place and its own tilt (--fx-tilt) .3 later than the previous one, over 1.1 with power3.out, fading in during the first .22. It starts when the top edge of the card group reaches the bottom of the screen.

options.dur: Length of one card (timeline share), default 1.1
options.pin: if off, only expands without pinning
options.[data-fx-part=card]: Card to unfold — its own tilt is set in style="--fx-tilt: -2.8"(Deg)
